[B8] < cloudA | userC : ('devices' : nils , 'members' : (userA , Members) , ...) , ... > $ userC 'removeUser' cloudA | (userA)
=> < cloudA | userC : ('devices' : nils , 'members' : Members , ...) , ... > .
[B9] < cloudA | ... > $ UserY 'retrieveCloudKey' cloudA | (deviceB)
=> < cloudA | ... > .
